purpose: Project exact scorer-native Pose and Seg costates onto compact, reconstructible G72 actuator coordinates for G92/G83 whole-state allocation.

current_base.identity: G85 exact P plus incumbent G74 A

costate_definition.pose: raw per-pair PoseNet six-scalar MSE VJP multiplied by the exact G85 population score derivative scale
costate_definition.seg: target-minus-current class-logit gap directional derivative, screened only on exact current mismatches
costate_definition.projection: collision-free role by direction by amplitude G72 grouped actuator coordinates
costate_definition.screening_pareto: unweighted minimize pose directional delta and maximize Seg gap directional delta
costate_definition.admission: forbidden locally; exact realized rows are inputs to G92/G83 whole-state selection

representation_scope.permitted_use: choose a family for exact hierarchical refinement and retain joint exact nonlinear replay
representation_scope.forbidden_use: rank atoms or infer a compact factorized program from a family aggregate
representation_scope.additive_attribution_gate: explicitly verify additivity and interactions; otherwise retain joint block coordinates

composition_law.historical_semantic_base: G78 and G87 describe P only and are donor/proposal custody, not current truth
composition_law.incumbent_affected_geometry: regenerated and checked against unaffected fresh G87 proposals
composition_law.candidate_y1: joint exact G74 realization of incumbent Y1 plus proposed atoms

pareto_screening_adversarial_verdict.scope: V1 finite-step first-order two-axis Pareto replay filter
pareto_screening_adversarial_verdict.reason: Directional signs reverse under exact realized R, so linearly dominated groups are not proved exact dominated.
pareto_screening_adversarial_verdict.v1_permitted_interpretation: replay-budget heuristic and coarse population atlas only
pareto_screening_adversarial_verdict.v2_gate: exact replay every deterministic collision-partitioned physical group per batch, or prove sign and rank fidelity inside a measured amplitude trust region before pruning
pareto_screening_adversarial_verdict.launch_guidance: finish active stage 0; do not launch stages 1 through 4 under V1 Pareto-as-filter interpretation

system_order: choose and exactly realize final semantic Y1 state from incumbent plus G89 or G90-derived program
reuse an exact G90 Seg delta only for the byte-identical measured Y1 mutation
use G91 only as initializer and factorability evidence, then solve Y0 conditioned on final Y1
serialize and price the sequential disjoint-frame product through G94
joint_state_costate_custody.seg_transfer_law: SegNet reads Y1 only; exact Seg fields transfer across a Y0-only change only when the exact measured Y1 mutation is reproduced byte-for-byte
joint_state_costate_custody.pose_transfer_law: none across either Y0 or Y1 state change; PoseNet reads both frames
joint_state_costate_custody.pose_invalidation: invalidate whenever either conditioning frame hash differs
joint_state_costate_custody.seg_invalidation: invalidate whenever the measured Y1 mutation hash differs

v2_required: separate scorer-authority inference cells from differentiable cells
use authority cells for exact realized replay
exact replay every deterministic collision-partitioned physical group and bind ordered group IDs and actual counts
new schemas and new SSD output root with immutable batch and stage checkpoints

structural_finding.statement: Finite-step realized-R response can reverse first-order Seg gap screening sign. Costates are proposal coordinates, not an admission oracle.
evidence: UndrivableBoundary d0 a1 had negative Seg gap directional delta but improved exact mismatch by 2835 cells.
Road d1 a0.5 had positive Seg gap directional delta but worsened exact mismatch by 1943 cells.
structural_finding.controller_requirement: G92/G83 must retain exact realized nonlinear rows and evaluate the composed population state rather than scalarize local derivatives.

resume_and_storage.checkpoint_policy: immutable atomic every batch and every 120-pair stage

consumer_contract.consumer: G92 whole-state allocator and G83 composition controller only
consumer_contract.basis: actuator_basis_groups contains exact proposed atom dictionaries and proposal fingerprints keyed by group_id
consumer_contract.coordinates: projection_rows keyed by operand_id; exact fields are non-null only for pareto_nondominated_operand_ids
consumer_contract.rate: exact_zip_delta_bytes remains null until an actual receiver-closed ZIP delta exists
consumer_contract.aggregate: not yet available; do not infer n600 from this bounded batch
